title: Meter Shop Rebill Period Standard: The Rebill Window after a Fast Meter Test on Electric Service by Rate Schedule
content:
**Standard.** When an Electric Service by Rate Schedule meter is found fast, the rebill window that the correction covers is set from the account's own records. The schedule's maximum number of corrected billing periods is 6 on all seven schedules.

| Record on the service account | The rebill window runs back |
|---|---|
| The latest test that found the meter within tolerance was performed less than 6 whole months before the current date | The whole months elapsed since that accurate test |
| No such recent accurate test, and the account's connect date is less than 6 whole months before the current date | The whole months elapsed since the connect date |
| Neither of the above | 6 whole months |

A window that runs back a number of whole months covers the lines dated less than that many whole months before the current date.

### Boundary cases (hypothetical; current date 2026-06-15)

| Latest within-tolerance test performed | Connect date | Window |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-02-03 (4 whole months before) | 2019-05-01 | 4 whole months |
| 2025-12-15 (exactly 6 whole months before — not less than 6) | 2019-05-01 | 6 whole months |
| 2025-10-01 | 2026-01-20 (4 whole months before) | 4 whole months |
| None | 2026-03-16 (2 whole months before) | 2 whole months |
| None | 2019-05-01 | 6 whole months |

### Points of reading

- The accurate test is the latest test on the same service account whose result was within tolerance, dated by the day the test was performed.
- An accurate test performed 6 or more whole months before the current date does not shorten the window.
